sourceText: No Bake Pineapple Cream Cake By: Anonymous Published: Monday, November 30, 2009 - 11:48pm Ingredients 4 cups vanilla wafer cookie crumbs 2 8-oz. cans crushed pineapple, drained 3 tablespoons butter, melted cup walnuts, chopped cup sugar 3 ounces cream cheese, softened 1 teaspoon vanilla Whipped cream Preparation 1 Sprinkle 1/3 of the cookie crumbs on the bottom of a 1-quart dish. Combine pineapple, butter, walnuts, sugar, cream cheese and vanilla and mix well. Place 1/2 of this mixture over cookie crumbs followed by 1/3 crumb mixture then the other 1/2 of pineapple mixture and top with remaining crumbs. Place in the refrigerator for several hours before serving. Top with whipped cream when serving. 2 Chefs Notes: Use light cream cheese and low fat whipped topping in place of the whipped cream. Comments: JerryDavidson Great post at least I think so. Thanks for enlightning this info. Jerry Davidson camera signal jammer
